-- Submit intent replay needs the complete immutable command and its current
-- lifecycle receipt. The normalized columns remain queryable; payload is the
-- canonical durable receipt consumed by the repository.
ALTER TABLE practice_submit_intents
    ADD COLUMN payload JSONB;

UPDATE practice_submit_intents
SET payload = jsonb_build_object(
    'task_instance_id', task_instance_id,
    'student_id', student_id,
    'idempotency_key', idempotency_key,
    'command_digest', command_digest,
    'submission_id', submission_id,
    'validation_run_id', validation_run_id,
    'scope', scope,
    'milestone_id', milestone_id,
    'validation_contract_digest', validation_contract_digest,
    'validation_specification', validation_specification,
    'status', status,
    'created_at', created_at,
    'snapshot', snapshot,
    'write_lock_id', write_lock_id,
    'fence_epoch', fence_epoch,
    'updated_at', updated_at
);

ALTER TABLE practice_submit_intents
    ALTER COLUMN payload SET NOT NULL;
